audit.note: follow_up_action( cs_event-popup_close ) on the dialog's Close button

deviations.what: the sap.m.IllustratedMessage control (since UI5 1.98) is newer than 1.71 and is the whole point of this sample - kept 1:1, the app needs a UI5 release >= 1.98.

the controller-built Dialog (Fragment.load of fragments/Dialog + addDependent + open) is shown with client->popup_display( ) of the same fragment, rebuilt 1:1; onDialogClose's close() is the roundtrip-free follow_up_action( cs_event-popup_close ) on the Close Button press.
